description: Imperial burgundy floor-length court gown over a cream linen underdress, with a low square neckline, fitted opaque bodice, elbow sleeves and gold woven borders along neckline, waist, cuffs, front and hem. Round gold belt clasps secure the waist. A cream wrap with gold borders rests on the arms; pendant necklace, earrings, bracelet, rings and decorated burgundy flats complete the outfit.
